div.head: EGu 6.4
div.ab: Gyf hwá ænigra godcundra gerihta forwyrna, gylde lahslitt mid Denum, wite mid Englum.
Gif hwá ænigra godcundra gerihto forwyrne, gylde lahslit mid Denum, wíte mid Englum.
Si quis Dei rectitudines aliquas difforciat, reddat lahslit cum Dacis, witam cum Anglis.
Gif hwá ænigra godcundra gerihto forwyrne, gylde lahslit mid Denum, wíte mid Englum.
Gif hwa ænigra godcundra gerihto forwyrne, gylde lahslit mid Denum, wite mid Englum.
If anyone refuses [to render] any church dues, he shall pay lahslit in a Danish district, and a fine in an English district.
If anyone withholds his Church dues, he shall pay lahslit among the Danes or a penalty among the English.
Wenn jemand irgend welche kirchlichen Gerechtsame verweigert, zahle er Rechtsbruchbusse bei den Dänen, Strafgeld bei den Engländern.
If anyone refuses any of the Church’s dues, let him pay the penalty for breach of law among the Danes, a fine among the English.
